'''Bluth''' was a sweet-smelling [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. It was also a name given to [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|females]].
